steps.title: Prepare reagents and solutions
steps.instruction: Make the following solutions: 70 % ethanol – mix 35 mL absolute ethanol with 15 mL water to 50 mL total; 75 % ethanol – mix 37.5 mL absolute ethanol with 12.5 mL water to 50 mL total; 10 N KOH – dissolve 28.1 g potassium hydroxide in 75 % ethanol and bring volume to 50 mL; Hexane/2‑propanol (3:2) with 0.01 % BHT – combine 60 mL hexane, 40 mL 2‑propanol and 10 mg dibutyl hydroxytoluene, make up to 100 mL; 0.1 N NaOH – dissolve 0.2 g sodium hydroxide in water and bring to 50 mL; PBS (1 L) – dissolve 8 g NaCl, 0.2 g KCl, 3.6 g Na₂HPO₄·12H₂O and 0.2 g KH₂PO₄ in water to 1 L. Store pyridine in a desiccator with silica gel at room temperature and use within four weeks after opening.

substeps.instruction: 70 % ethanol: 35 mL ethanol + 15 mL H₂O → 50 mL
75 % ethanol: 37.5 mL ethanol + 12.5 mL H₂O → 50 mL
10 N KOH: 28.1 g KOH + 75 % ethanol up to 50 mL
Hexane/2‑propanol (3:2) + 0.01 % BHT: 60 mL hexane + 40 mL 2‑propanol + 10 mg BHT → 100 mL
0.1 N NaOH: 0.2 g NaOH + H₂O up to 50 mL
PBS (1 L): 8 g NaCl + 0.2 g KCl + 3.6 g Na₂HPO₄·12H₂O + 0.2 g KH₂PO₄ + H₂O up to 1 L

steps.title: Seed CHO‑K1 cells
steps.instruction: Plate CHO‑K1 cells in triplicate into 6‑well plates at 2 × 10⁵ cells per well. Incubate in DMEM/Ham’s F‑12 supplemented with 7.5 % FBS, 100 U mL⁻¹ penicillin and 0.1 mg mL⁻¹ streptomycin at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 18–24 h. Replace medium with Opti‑MEM 2–3 h before transfection.

steps.title: Transfect CHO‑K1 cells
steps.instruction: Transfect each well with 2 µg of plasmid (pFLAG‑CH25H, pCYP7A1‑FLAG, pCYP27A1‑FLAG or pCYP46A1‑FLAG) using Lipofectamine LTX according to the manufacturer’s protocol. Five hours post‑transfection, change medium to DMEM/Ham’s F‑12 containing 0.1 % FBS, 100 U mL⁻¹ penicillin and 0.1 mg mL⁻¹ streptomycin. Incubate for 24 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ before harvesting.

steps.title: Seed and induce CHO‑CH25H tet‑on cells
steps.instruction: Plate 2 × 10⁵ CHO‑CH25H tet‑on cells per well in triplicate into 6‑well plates. Incubate 18–24 h in DMEM/Ham’s F‑12 with 7.5 % FBS, 100 U mL⁻¹ penicillin and 0.1 mg mL⁻¹ streptomycin at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. Treat cells for 24 h with either 0, 0.4 or 1 µg mL⁻¹ doxycycline hyclate in DMEM/Ham’s F‑12 containing 0.1 % FBS and the same antibiotics. Harvest cells for lipid extraction.

steps.title: Seed and stimulate J774.1 cells
steps.instruction: Plate J774.1 cells in triplicate into 6‑well plates at 5 × 10⁵ cells per well. Incubate for two days in RPMI‑1640 supplemented with 10 % FBS, 100 U mL⁻¹ penicillin and 0.1 mg mL⁻¹ streptomycin at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. Add 100 ng mL⁻¹ Kdo₂‑Lipid A (or leave untreated) and incubate for 20 h at 37 °C before lipid extraction.

steps.title: Wash and extract cellular lipids
steps.instruction: Wash each well twice with 1.5 mL PBS, then let plates dry at room temperature. Add 1.5 mL hexane/2‑propanol (3:2) containing 0.01 % BHT to each well and incubate 1 h at room temperature. Transfer the solvent to a screw‑top test tube. Add a further 1 mL of the same solvent to the well, incubate 30 min, then combine with the first extract in the same tube. Spike each tube with internal standards: cholesterol‑d₇ (100 ng per tube from a 5 µg mL⁻¹ stock in chloroform) and 25‑hydroxycholesterol‑d₆ (10 ng per tube from a 1 µg mL⁻¹ stock in methanol). Evaporate the pooled solvent under a nitrogen gas stream at room temperature using a pressured‑gas blowing concentrator (MGS‑2200).

steps.title: Saponify lipid extracts
steps.instruction: To each dried tube add 1 mL 100 % ethanol and 300 µL 10 N KOH (prepared in 75 % ethanol). Close the tube with a screw cap, mix gently and incubate at 80 °C for 1 h to saponify lipids. Cool the tubes on ice.

steps.title: Extract non‑saponified sterols
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL chloroform to each tube, vortex, then add 2.5 mL distilled water and vortex again. Centrifuge at 2,380 × g for 10 min at room temperature using a low‑speed refrigerated centrifuge (AX‑511). Remove the upper aqueous phase with an aspirator. Add 2 mL distilled water, vortex 1 min, centrifuge as before and discard the aqueous layer. Repeat a third wash with 2 mL water, vortex, centrifuge and discard the aqueous phase. Transfer the lower chloroform phase (containing non‑saponified sterols) to a Mighty vial and dry under a nitrogen gas stream.

steps.title: Derivatize sterols for GC‑MS
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL pyridine and 50 µL N‑methyl‑N‑(trimethylsilyl) trifluoroacetamide (MSTFA) to each dried vial, mix gently and incubate at 80 °C for 1 h with agitation at 300 rpm using an Eppendorf ThermoMixer C. Transfer the derivatized solution to a TORAST vial equipped with a TORAST insert using a Hamilton microsyringe and seal with a TORAST vial cap.

steps.title: Prepare standard sterol mixtures
steps.instruction: In separate vials prepare (a) a non‑hydroxysterol mixture containing cholesterol, cholesterol‑d₇, desmosterol, 7‑dehydrocholesterol, lathosterol, lanosterol and 24,25‑dihydrolanosterol; (b) an oxysterol mixture containing 4β‑hydroxycholesterol, 7α‑hydroxycholesterol, 7β‑hydroxycholesterol, 24(S)‑hydroxycholesterol, 25‑hydroxycholesterol, 25‑hydroxycholesterol‑d₆, 27‑hydroxycholesterol, 7α,25‑dihydroxycholesterol, 7α,27‑dihydroxycholesterol and 24,25‑epoxycholesterol. Add each sterol at the following amounts per vial: non‑hydroxysterols – 0.1, 1, 5, 10, 50 and 100 ng; oxysterols – 0.01, 0.1, 0.5, 1, 5, 10 and 20 ng. Dry the mixtures under a nitrogen gas stream at room temperature. Dissolve each dried mixture in 50 µL pyridine plus 50 µL MSTFA, incubate 1 h at 80 °C with agitation at 300 rpm, then transfer to a TORAST vial with insert and seal.

steps.title: Configure GC‑MS/MS parameters
steps.instruction:
Program the GC‑MS/TQ8040 NX with a BPX5 column (30 m × 0.25 mm, 0.25 µm film) and an Rxi guard column (5 m × 0.25 mm). Use the AOC‑20i autosampler in splitless mode, injector temperature 275 °C, carrier‑gas linear velocity 49.5 cm s⁻¹, high‑pressure injection 250 kPa for 1 min. Oven program: 200 °C (hold 1 min) → ramp 25 °C min⁻¹ to 250 °C → ramp 15 °C min⁻¹ to 290 °C → ramp 5 °C min⁻¹ to 320 °C (hold 2 min). MS interface temperature 280 °C, ion‑source temperature 230 °C, loop time 0.3 s. Set measurement mode to multiple‑reaction monitoring (MRM) and enter the following transitions (quantification ion → product ion, collision energy) and retention times (min):
- 7α‑hydroxycholesterol: RT 8.48, 456 → 208.3 (CE 18); confirm 456 → 119 (CE 30), 456 → 95.2 (CE 33)
- Cholesterol‑d₇: RT 8.89, 336 → 121.1 (CE 18); confirm 375 → 145.1 (CE 18), 336 → 109.2 (CE 18)
- Cholesterol: RT 8.94, 368 → 145.1 (CE 21); confirm 329 → 95.1 (CE 27), 329 → 81.1 (CE 24)
- Desmosterol: RT 9.24, 129 → 73 (CE 15); confirm 129 → 57.9 (CE 30), 129 → 127.1 (CE 15)
- 7‑dehydrocholesterol: RT 9.28, 351 → 145.1 (CE 30); confirm 351 → 128.1 (CE 42)
- 7β‑hydroxycholesterol: RT 9.38, 456 → 233.2 (CE 18); confirm 233 → 73.1 (CE 24)
- Lathosterol: RT 9.41, 213 → 157.2 (CE 12); confirm 213 → 81.1 (CE 15)
- 4β‑hydroxycholesterol: RT 9.61, 366 → 158.3 (CE 18); confirm 366 → 129.1 (CE 36)
- 24,25‑dihydrolanosterol: RT 10.01, 395 → 145.2 (CE 30); confirm 395 → 107 (CE 30)
- 7α,25‑dihydroxycholesterol: RT 10.21, 131 → 73.1 (CE 18); confirm 544 → 73.2 (CE 39)
- Lanosterol: RT 10.36, 393 → 95.2 (CE 24); confirm 393 → 187.4 (CE 12)
- 24,25‑epoxycholesterol: RT 10.44, 143 → 73.1 (CE 18); confirm 129 → 73.1 (CE 15), 143 → 128.1 (CE 18)
- 24(S)‑hydroxycholesterol: RT 10.60, 159 → 69.1 (CE 9); confirm 159 → 73.1 (CE 18)
- 7α,27‑dihydroxycholesterol: RT 10.60, 103 → 73.1 (CE 9); confirm 544 → 233.2 (CE 33)
- 25‑hydroxycholesterol‑d₆: RT 10.75, 137 → 73.2 (CE 15); confirm 137 → 58.2 (CE 30)
- 25‑hydroxycholesterol: RT 10.79, 131 → 73.2 (CE 9); confirm 131 → 58.1 (CE 30)
- 27‑hydroxycholesterol: RT 11.26, 129 → 73.1 (CE 15); confirm 456 → 131.2 (CE 42), 456 → 417 (CE 42).

steps.title: Inject samples into GC‑MS
steps.instruction: Inject 1 µL of each derivatized sample or standard mixture into the GC‑MS/TQ8040 NX using the AOC‑20i autosampler in splitless mode under the conditions described above. Detect the 17 sterols by MRM as programmed.

steps.title: Perform cellular protein assay
steps.instruction: After lipid extraction, add 1 mL of 0.1 N NaOH to each well and incubate at room temperature for 20–24 h to solubilize cellular protein. Mix the lysate, transfer 10 µL to a well of a 96‑well plate, add 150 µL BCA assay reagent, incubate 30 min at 37 °C, and measure absorbance at 562 nm with a plate reader (SpectraMax M2e). Determine protein concentration using a bovine serum albumin standard curve.
